specs.Compatible Devices: Cellphones, Desktops, Gaming Consoles, Laptops, Tablets

features: Hi-Res LDAC Audio for Superior Sound - Experience premium audio with bluetooth headphones featuring Hi-Res LDAC support. Enjoy deep bass, clear vocals, and detailed sound for music, movies, and immersive listening.

Adaptive ANC up to 45dB Noise Cancellation - Block unwanted noise with noise cancelling headphones featuring adaptive ANC up to 45dB. Enjoy distraction-free audio at work, travel, or daily use with these wireless headphones.
Up to 120 Hours Battery Life - Stay powered longer with wireless headphones offering up to 120 hours of playtime. Perfect for travel, work, and long listening sessions without frequent charging.
Low Latency up to 80ms for Gaming & Streaming - Enjoy lag-free audio with bluetooth headphones featuring ultra-low latency up to 80ms. Ideal for gaming, videos, and seamless audio-video sync.
Comfort Cushions for All-Day Use - Designed for comfort, these over ear headphones come with soft ear cushions and an ergonomic fit, making them perfect for long listening, work, and travel
